name: agentic-skill-router
description: Route requests to disabled Agent Skills with fast corpus routing, and manage installed skills based on usage.

interface.shortDescription: Route and manage stale Agent Skills
interface.longDescription: Agentic Skill Router routes long-tail requests to disabled Agent Skills using metadata, lexical, and bounded body search, audits installed skills, suggests unused or stale entries, and safely disables selected skills by renaming SKILL.md files so they can be restored later.
defaultPrompt: Route this request to a disabled skill
